name: Blockchair
tagline: Researching Blockchair API details from official sources
description: Multi-chain blockchain data API: stats, blocks, transactions, addresses, and more across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other chains.

auth.details: Occasional/testing requests allowed without a key. API keys (when used) are passed as the query parameter ?key=YOUR_API_KEY on the request URL (e.g. https://api.blockchair.com/bitcoin/blocks?key=MYSECRETKEY). Keep keys server-side.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 1,000 requests/day (soft limit); limited endpoints. Without a key: ~30 req/min. Paid plans raise daily and RPM caps.

rate_limits: Without key: ~30 RPM. Free plan key: ~1,000 req/day (soft). Paid plans: higher daily limits and RPM; see pricing.
use_cases: get blockchain network statistics across supported chains
look up a transaction by hash
retrieve an address balance and transaction history
fetch recent blocks and their details
analyze token transfers for an Ethereum address
